d:
Apple’s first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, brings a new design, a crease-free inner display and an iPad mini-like viewing experience. But does the foldable form factor justify the compromises?
In this review, Nandagopal Rajan, CEO of Indian Express Digital, shares his experience of using the iPhone Duo for a week, including a trip to San Francisco. He explores its design and hinge, inner and outer displays, app compatibility, Touch ID, camera performance and battery life. He also looks at what works, what doesn't, and who should consider buying Apple's first foldable iPhone.
